source_scope: The source audits establish individually inspected pages and examples. This metadata check is not a full-book historical-phonology audit.

coordinator_image_checks.scope: Section 62: æ→ea, e→eo, i→io; distinguish the l+C environments by vowel and the r+j exception. Long-front-vowel breaking has a separate h environment.
Sections 73–74: earlier raising before i/j versus later front mutation; fronting/raising and lost conditioning sounds.
Section 76: practical grouping e→i and ēo→īe is not a historically exact grouping under i-umlaut.
Section 21: Cook corrects his schematic a to historical æ; broad breaking conditions need the source-specific qualifications supplied by Fulk.
